description: Minimum wall thickness >= 1.5mm for CNC milled parts
look_for: Thin walls, webs, and fins throughout the part geometry
pass_criteria: All walls and webs appear to be at least 1.5mm thick relative to adjacent features
fail_criteria: Any wall, web, or fin that appears thinner than 1.5mm or looks fragile relative to its height
source: Boothroyd, Dewhurst & Knight — Product Design for Manufacture and Assembly
fix_hint: Increase wall thickness: use .shell(-thickness) with a larger negative value, or widen the solid body before cutting.

description: Pocket depth-to-width ratio should not exceed 4:1
look_for: Deep pockets, slots, or cavities in the part geometry
pass_criteria: No pocket appears deeper than 4x its narrowest width dimension
fail_criteria: Any pocket or slot where the depth visibly exceeds 4x the width, indicating tool deflection risk
source: Machining guidelines — tool deflection and chatter prevention
fix_hint: Reduce pocket depth or widen the pocket. Use .rect(wider, wider).cutBlind(-shallower_depth) instead.

description: [RETIRED — fillets deferred] Internal corner radius >= 1.5mm (standard end mill radius)
look_for: Inside corners at pocket floors, wall intersections, and step transitions
pass_criteria: All internal corners show visible fillet radius of at least 1.5mm
fail_criteria: Any sharp 90-degree internal corner with no visible radius or fillet
source: CNC machining — end mill geometry requires internal corner radii

description: Avoid undercuts and features inaccessible to standard 3-axis end mills
look_for: Overhanging features, T-slots, dovetails, or cavities with restricted top access
pass_criteria: All features are accessible from the top or sides by a straight vertical tool path
fail_criteria: Any feature that would require a hook tool, undercut mill, or 5-axis machine to produce
fix_hint: Ensure all features are accessible from top-down. Avoid creating geometry under overhangs. Use simple extrusions and cuts rather than complex swept shapes.

description: Hole depth-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 10:1 for standard drills
look_for: Deep through-holes and blind holes in the part geometry
pass_criteria: No hole appears deeper than 10x its diameter
fail_criteria: Any hole where the depth visibly exceeds 10x the diameter, risking drill wander or breakage
source: Standard drill bit limitations — twist drill aspect ratio
fix_hint: Use .hole(diameter, depth) with depth <= 10*diameter. For deeper holes, split into pilot + finish holes or use .cboreHole().

description: Avoid thin ribs and webs (< 2mm thick at depth > 4x thickness)
look_for: Tall thin ribs, fins, or web sections that could vibrate or deflect during machining
pass_criteria: All ribs and webs have thickness proportional to their height (height < 4x thickness)
fail_criteria: Any rib thinner than 2mm with unsupported height exceeding 4x its thickness
source: CNC machining — thin feature vibration and tool chatter
fix_hint: Increase rib thickness or reduce rib height. Use .rect(thicker_width, height).extrude(depth) for ribs.

description: All edges should be accessible for deburring operations
look_for: Internal edges, intersections, and transitions where burrs would form during machining
pass_criteria: All machined edges are accessible for manual or mechanical deburring
fail_criteria: Any machined edge in a recessed or enclosed area where deburring tools cannot reach
fix_hint: Ensure all edges are accessible. Avoid enclosed internal edges. Use chamfers (.chamfer(0.5)) instead of fillets for edge breaks.

description: Tapped hole thread depth >= 1.5x nominal bolt diameter
look_for: Threaded holes, bolt holes designated as tapped (not clearance)
pass_criteria: Tapped holes have sufficient depth for full thread engagement (>= 1.5x diameter)
fail_criteria: Any tapped hole where the material thickness appears less than 1.5x the hole diameter
source: Mechanical fastening — thread engagement strength requirements
fix_hint: Ensure material thickness >= 1.5x bolt diameter at tapped hole locations. Use .faces("selector").workplane().hole(diameter, depth) with adequate depth.

description: Minimum internal bore diameter >= 3mm for standard boring bars
look_for: Internal bores, through-holes on turned parts, and center holes
pass_criteria: All internal bores appear to be at least 3mm in diameter
fail_criteria: Any internal bore that appears smaller than 3mm diameter
source: CNC turning — minimum boring bar diameter constraints
fix_hint: Use .circle(radius).cutThruAll() with radius >= 1.5mm (diameter >= 3mm) for internal bores.

description: Length-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 8:1 to avoid deflection
look_for: Long slender turned parts, shafts, pins, and cylindrical features
pass_criteria: The overall part length does not exceed 8x the minimum turned diameter
fail_criteria: Part length exceeds 8x the minimum diameter, indicating tailstock support or steady rest needed
source: CNC turning — workpiece deflection and chatter prevention
fix_hint: Shorten the part or increase diameter. L/D ratio must be <= 8:1. Consider splitting into multiple turned sections.

description: Internal features must be accessible from one end of the workpiece
look_for: Internal grooves, shoulders, or steps inside bores
pass_criteria: All internal features are accessible from at least one open end of the part
fail_criteria: Any internal feature that is enclosed on both sides with no tool access path
source: CNC turning — boring bar and internal tooling access
fix_hint: Ensure internal grooves are accessible from at least one end. Use .faces("<Z").workplane() to cut from the accessible end.

description: Groove width >= 3mm for standard grooving/parting tools
look_for: External and internal grooves, O-ring seats, and parting features on turned parts
pass_criteria: All grooves appear at least 3mm wide to accommodate standard tooling
fail_criteria: Any groove narrower than 3mm requiring specialty thin-blade tooling
source: CNC turning — standard grooving tool width constraints
fix_hint: Use .faces().workplane().rect(width, depth).cutBlind() with width >= 3mm for grooves.

description: Wall thickness should be uniform (variation < 25% across the part)
look_for: Wall sections, comparing thin areas to thick areas throughout the part
pass_criteria: Wall thickness appears consistent throughout, with no section more than 25% thicker or thinner than adjacent sections
fail_criteria: Visible thickness variation exceeding 25% between adjacent wall sections, causing sink marks and warping
source: Injection molding — uniform cooling and shrinkage requirements
fix_hint: Use .shell(-uniform_thickness) to create uniform walls. Avoid mixing thick and thin sections.

description: Draft angle >= 1 degree on all vertical walls for mold release
look_for: Vertical walls perpendicular to the parting plane of the mold
pass_criteria: All vertical walls show a slight taper (draft angle) away from the mold pull direction
fail_criteria: Any perfectly vertical wall with zero draft angle, which would prevent clean mold release
source: Injection molding — mold release and ejection requirements
fix_hint: Add draft angle: use .taper(1) or create angled walls with .polyline() profiles that include 1-degree tapers.

description: [RETIRED — fillets deferred] No sharp internal corners — use radii for mold flow and stress reduction
look_for: Inside corners where walls meet, base-to-wall junctions, and rib roots
pass_criteria: All internal corners have visible fillet radii (typically >= 0.5x wall thickness)
fail_criteria: Any sharp 90-degree internal corner without a fillet, causing flow hesitation and stress concentration
source: Injection molding — resin flow and part strength at corners

description: Rib thickness should not exceed 60% of adjoining wall thickness
look_for: Ribs, gussets, and reinforcement features protruding from wall surfaces
pass_criteria: All ribs appear thinner than the wall they connect to (approximately 50-60% of wall thickness)
fail_criteria: Any rib that appears as thick as or thicker than the adjoining wall, causing sink marks on the opposite face
source: Injection molding — sink mark prevention at rib-wall intersections
fix_hint: Make ribs thinner than walls: rib_thickness = wall_thickness * 0.6. Use .rect(rib_thickness, rib_height).extrude(rib_depth).

description: Minimum bend radius >= material thickness
look_for: Bends, flanges, and folds in the sheet metal part geometry
pass_criteria: All bend radii appear at least as large as the material thickness (no sharp creases)
fail_criteria: Any bend with a radius smaller than the material thickness, risking cracking on the outer surface
source: Sheet metal forming — minimum bend radius to prevent cracking
fix_hint: Increase bend radius in your sheet metal profile. When using .polyline() for bent profiles, add arc segments at bends with radius >= material thickness.

description: Hole diameter >= material thickness for clean punching
look_for: Punched holes, slots, and cutouts in the sheet metal blank area
pass_criteria: All holes appear at least as large in diameter as the material thickness
fail_criteria: Any hole smaller than the material thickness, requiring expensive laser cutting or causing punch breakage
source: Sheet metal — punch tooling minimum hole size
fix_hint: Increase hole diameter to at least the material thickness. Use .hole(max(desired_dia, material_thickness)).

description: Edge-to-hole distance >= 2x material thickness
look_for: Holes positioned near the edge of the sheet metal part
pass_criteria: All holes are at least 2x material thickness from the nearest part edge
fail_criteria: Any hole positioned closer than 2x material thickness to an edge, risking material deformation or tearing
source: Sheet metal — edge distance requirements for structural integrity
fix_hint: Move holes away from edges: center holes at least 2x material thickness from any edge. Adjust workplane offset accordingly.

description: Bend-to-hole distance >= 2.5x material thickness plus bend radius
look_for: Holes positioned near bend lines in the flat pattern
pass_criteria: All holes are positioned far enough from bends to avoid distortion during forming
fail_criteria: Any hole too close to a bend line, which would distort the hole during the bending operation
source: Sheet metal — hole-to-bend distance for dimensional accuracy
fix_hint: Move holes away from bend lines. Ensure hole centers are at least 2.5x material_thickness + bend_radius from any bend.

description: Minimum wall thickness >= 0.8mm (FDM) or >= 0.4mm (SLA)
look_for: Thin walls, shells, and membrane-like features in the part geometry
pass_criteria: All walls appear thick enough for the printing process (>= 0.8mm for FDM, >= 0.4mm for SLA)
fail_criteria: Any wall or shell thinner than 0.8mm that would fail to print or be extremely fragile
source: Additive manufacturing — minimum printable feature size by process
fix_hint: Increase wall thickness in the design: use .shell(-thickness) with thickness >= 0.8mm for FDM or >= 0.4mm for SLA.

description: Overhang angle should not exceed 45 degrees from vertical without support
look_for: Overhanging features, bridges, and surfaces that angle away from vertical
pass_criteria: All overhanging surfaces are within 45 degrees of vertical, or the design accounts for support structures
fail_criteria: Any overhang exceeding 45 degrees from vertical with no visible support features or self-supporting geometry
fix_hint: Redesign overhangs to be <= 45 degrees from vertical. Use self-supporting angles or add support features in the geometry.

description: Minimum feature size >= 0.5mm for reliable printing
look_for: Small protrusions, thin pins, embossed text, and fine detail features
pass_criteria: All small features appear at least 0.5mm in their smallest dimension
fail_criteria: Any feature smaller than 0.5mm that would be unreliable or impossible to print
source: Additive manufacturing — minimum reliable feature resolution
fix_hint: Increase minimum feature dimensions to >= 0.5mm. Avoid pins, text, or protrusions smaller than this.

description: [RETIRED — fillets deferred] No sharp external edges where handling could cause injury or damage
look_for: External edges, corners, and transitions that a person would touch during handling
pass_criteria: All external edges that would be handled have visible chamfers or fillets
fail_criteria: Any sharp external edge or knife-like corner on a surface likely to be touched during handling or assembly
source: General manufacturing — operator safety and part handling

description: All features must have adequate clearance for manufacturing tool access
look_for: Recessed features, internal cavities, deep holes, and areas where tooling might not reach
pass_criteria: All features can be reached by appropriate manufacturing tools from at least one direction
fail_criteria: Any feature in a location where no standard tool could physically reach to create it
source: General manufacturing — tool access and fixturing requirements
fix_hint: Ensure all features have clear tool access paths. Avoid features hidden behind other geometry. Use simple cuts accessible from standard directions.

description: Prefer symmetric features to reduce setup operations and fixturing complexity
look_for: Part overall symmetry, feature placement patterns, and potential for simplified fixturing
pass_criteria: Part geometry takes advantage of symmetry where functional requirements allow, reducing required setups
fail_criteria: Asymmetric feature placement that requires additional setups when a symmetric design would serve the same function
source: DFM principles — setup reduction through design symmetry
fix_hint: Where possible, mirror features symmetrically. Use .mirror("XZ") or .mirror("YZ") for symmetric hole patterns.

look_for: Rounded or complex external surfaces without any flat areas for clamping.
pass_criteria: The part has sufficient flat, parallel surfaces to be securely held in a vise or chuck.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Parts should include stable fixturing surfaces for manufacturing operations.
fail_criteria: The part's primary locating and clamping surfaces are rounded, tapered, or irregular, complicating fixturing.

pass_criteria: All internal pocket floors have a visible fillet or radius where they meet the walls.
look_for: Sharp 90-degree corners where a vertical wall meets the floor of a pocket.
fail_criteria: Any internal pocket floor has a perfectly sharp corner, which requires specialized tooling or is impossible to machine.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Internal pocket floor corners must have a radius.

fail_criteria: Horizontal circular holes that will sag without support.
pass_criteria: Horizontal holes have a teardrop shape or are small enough to bridge reliably.
look_for: Circular holes oriented horizontally (parallel to the build plate).
description: Horizontal holes should use a teardrop profile to prevent sagging at the top of the hole.

look_for: Flat mating surfaces between enclosures without any interlocking or aligning geometry.
pass_criteria: Presence of a lip, groove, or alignment pins on the mating surface.
description: [RETIRED — Arbiter (mission control, 2026-07-21): cross-rulebook duplicate of active DFA-002 (self-locating mating features); assembly-level concern mis-homed as per-part DFM rule (evaluator cannot see the mating counterpart per-part); times_applied=20 evidence inflated by the empty-manufacturing global-rule bug. DFA-002 remains the canonical home for this defect class.] Lids and mating enclosures should have alignment features such as a lip, flange, or pins to ensure proper registration.
fail_criteria: Perfectly flat mating surfaces that rely solely on hinges or external fasteners for alignment.
Internal corners are perfectly sharp (0 radius).
look_for: Sharp 90-degree internal corners, especially in cutouts or pockets.
pass_criteria: Internal corners have a visible fillet radius.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Sharp internal corners should be filleted to reduce stress concentrations and prevent cracking.

pass_criteria: Presence of a handle, protruding tab, or recessed indentation on the side opposite the hinge.
description: [RETIRED — triage: out_of_scope] Lids and doors should have a handle, tab, or indentation to facilitate user opening.
look_for: Features designed for user grip or leverage to open the enclosure.
fail_criteria: Smooth exterior with no obvious way to grip or pry open the lid.

look_for: Sharp 90-degree external edges on the part perimeter.
fail_criteria: External edges are perfectly sharp.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Sharp external edges should be chamfered or filleted for handling safety and to reduce chipping.
pass_criteria: External edges have a visible chamfer or fillet.

look_for: Sharp internal corners in pockets or cavities in the plane perpendicular to tool axis.
pass_criteria: All internal vertical corners have a visible radius greater than zero.
fail_criteria: Perfectly sharp internal vertical corners that cannot be machined by a rotating cylindrical tool.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Internal vertical corners must have a minimum radius to accommodate the cylindrical shape of an end mill.

look_for: Sharp edges at the entrances of through holes or blind holes meant for mating parts.
pass_criteria: Hole entrances have a visible chamfer.
fail_criteria: Hole entrances have perfectly sharp 90-degree edges.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Holes intended for pin or shaft insertion should have a chamfered lead-in to facilitate assembly.

pass_criteria: Ends of the pin have a visible chamfer or radius.
fail_criteria: Ends of the pin are perfectly sharp 90-degree edges.
description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Pins and shafts intended for insertion into holes should have chamfered or radiused ends to facilitate assembly and prevent binding.
look_for: Sharp edges on the ends of cylindrical pins or shafts.

pass_criteria: Part is fully rotationally symmetric.
look_for: Flats, slits, off-axis holes, or other non-rotationally symmetric features on a turned part.
description: Turned parts should be rotationally symmetric; non-symmetric features require secondary milling operations.
fail_criteria: Presence of non-symmetric features that cannot be created on a standard 2-axis lathe.
Smooth cylinder with no axial retention features.
look_for: Grooves near the ends of the pin or cross-holes.
description: Cylindrical pins intended for floating assembly should have retaining ring grooves or other axial retention features.
pass_criteria: Presence of retaining grooves or holes.

fail_criteria: A solid continuous ring that cannot be assembled onto its intended mating captive shaft.
look_for: Solid, continuous rings for bearing holes that need to be assembled onto a captive shaft (like a crankshaft journal).
pass_criteria: The bearing hole is split with a removable cap and fastener holes.
description: Closed-loop bearing holes intended for assembly over captive shafts must be split into two pieces with fastening features.
[RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Gear module/tooth size must be large relative to the printer's minimum feature so the involute flank and root are reproduced accurately for correct meshing.
look_for: Tooth count vs. outer diameter (effective module) and root-fillet size relative to nozzle/laser resolution.
pass_criteria: Module yields tooth thickness and root well above the process minimum feature (>= ~1mm module for FDM as a practical floor).
fail_criteria: Very fine-pitch teeth on a small pinion where nozzle width blurs the involute profile and root.

description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Press-fit bores (bearing seats, dowel bores) must have a lead-in chamfer at the entry face
look_for: The entry edge of any bore that receives a press-fit or interference-fit component; check for a visible chamfer ring distinct from the counterbore step
pass_criteria: Bore entry shows a chamfer of roughly 0.5-1.0mm at 30-45 degrees on the face the component is inserted from
fail_criteria: Bore entry is a sharp 90-degree edge, which shaves the outer race during insertion, raises a burr into the seat, and causes cocked or galled assembly

description: [RETIRED — triage: legacy_low_evidence] Bearing-seat bores must declare a fit class and the seat depth must be shorter than the bearing outer-race width so the race seats on the shoulder, not the bore floor
look_for: Any counterbored seat sized for a rolling-element bearing; check that the design source states a bore tolerance (e.g. H7) and that the counterbore depth is dimensioned relative to the bearing width
pass_criteria: Bore carries an explicit fit-class tolerance and the counterbore depth is less than the bearing race width so the race protrudes and can be pressed against the shoulder
fail_criteria: Bore is dimensioned nominal-only (implying a general +/- machining tolerance, which is 5-10x too loose for a press fit), or the seat is deeper than the race width so the bearing bottoms out unpredictably

description: [RETIRED — triage: legacy_low_evidence] Thin cantilevered features must be evaluated for machining deflection and chatter, not only for static minimum thickness.
look_for: Ribs, blades, vanes, and fins anchored on one edge only, with a free tip and free top edge; assess unsupported length and height against thickness.
pass_criteria: Free length and unsupported height are both within roughly 10x and 4x the feature thickness respectively, or a support strategy (tip shroud, tie ring, sacrificial fill) is declared.
fail_criteria: A cantilevered feature whose free length exceeds ~10x its thickness with no tip support and no declared support strategy — it will chatter, deflect, and finish out of tolerance even though it satisfies the static minimum-thickness rule.

description: [RETIRED — triage: legacy_low_evidence] A component seat whose nominal depth exactly equals the nominal width of the component it receives must carry a directional (one-sided) tolerance when the seat's open face is a clearance or assembly datum.
look_for: Any counterbore, pocket, or shoulder whose depth parameter is set equal to a purchased component's nominal width, where the resulting flush face is referenced by a downstream running clearance, gasket gap, or mating-face dimension.
pass_criteria: The seat depth carries a one-sided tolerance biased in the safe direction (component recessed rather than proud, or vice versa as the function demands), and the resulting worst-case flushness error is stated against the clearance it feeds.
fail_criteria: Seat depth equals component width at nominal with a symmetric or unstated tolerance, so a normal machining deviation makes the component stand proud and consume the downstream clearance with no design margin.

description: [RETIRED — triage: fillet_policy] Through-holes that exit on a locating or mounting datum face must be chamfered or explicitly called out for exit-side deburring.
look_for: Drilled through-holes whose exit face is the part's mounting/ground plane or any other face that seats against a mating flat; check for an exit chamfer or a deburr callout.
pass_criteria: Exit edges on datum faces carry a chamfer (typically 0.3-0.5 mm) or the drawing/constraints explicitly requires deburring that face after drilling.
fail_criteria: Sharp drilled exits on a seating face with no chamfer and no deburr callout - the raised burr ring lifts the part off its mounting surface, causing rock, non-repeatable seating, and angular misalignment of any bore the part carries.

description: [RETIRED — triage: legacy_low_evidence] Large-diameter thin discs must declare a fixturing datum and clamping scheme, because clamping location dominates achievable flatness and runout.
look_for: Any disc whose axial thickness is less than roughly 1/20 of its outer diameter.
pass_criteria: The design declares the fixturing datum (typically the bore plus one faced surface) and the clamp locations.
fail_criteria: A thin disc with no declared fixturing scheme, which will be rim-clamped by default and dish under load.

description: [RETIRED — triage: legacy_low_evidence] A hub bore intended to transmit torque must carry an explicit torque-transmission feature or an explicit statement that the joint is friction-clamped.
look_for: Keyway, spline, set-screw flat, taper, or a stated clamp-nut arrangement on a driven bore.
pass_criteria: One torque-transmission feature is present, or friction clamping is explicitly declared with the clamp force path named.
fail_criteria: A plain cylindrical bore on a driven rotor with no key, no spline, no set-screw, and no declared clamping scheme.
